proposal.reason: Main functional change is review-routing withdrawal behavior in contribution workflow automation: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds withdraw_review_requests() and pending_review_requests() to preserve bot/team requests while withdrawing only managed pending humans, with snapshot/history conflict checks and fail-closed rerun errors. .github/scripts/reviewer_api.py adds GitHub.graphql() and GraphQLError for typed GraphQL reads/mutation with bounded redacted diagnostics. This is review-policy automation logic, so workflow takes priority; no independent CI/build/runtime PCCL module contract change is evidenced.
